pre_registration.decision: B -- movements 5 and 8 kept as an explicit negative control

rationale.5: DEFINED by inter-finger abduction. canonical16 removes all four non-thumb MCP ab/adduction DOF by design, so the defining information is absent. Pre-registered negative control.
rationale.8: DEFINED by inter-finger adduction ('fingers closed together'). Same reason as movement 5. Pre-registered negative control.

pre_registration.why: canonical16 removes the four non-thumb MCP ab/adduction DOF by design; movements 5 and 8 are defined by those DOF, so their defining information is absent from the representation. Freezing this before test evaluation.
